releaseNotes:
Room time reminder now alerts 10 minutes before a room's booked time ends (was 15 minutes).
Orders transferred between floors now show up for the cashier of the new floor (ground floor ↔ 2nd floor).
History tab: pick a date range to view settled and cancelled orders from past days.
History tab: new Total Settled card showing the whole day's settled total, settled and cancelled counts, and a breakdown by payment method.
History tab: when viewing several days, orders are grouped by day, each with its own settled total.
Activity tab: pick a date range to view the activity log for past days.
New date picker with quick picks: Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, Last Month.
On 2nd floor accounts, the History tab now only lists 2nd floor orders.
Clearer payment labels: "Tendered" is now "Cash" (or GCash / Maya / Card), and "Total Paid" is now "Total".
